name: Clone Robotics
headquarters: Wroclaw, Poland (second office in Mountain View, California)
summary: Clone Robotics builds musculoskeletal androids driven by water-powered Myofiber artificial muscles. It was co-founded by Dhanush Radhakrishnan and Lukasz Kozlik.
funding: About $17 million raised to date, with a $50 million round reported in progress in April 2026.

sources.title: The Synthetic Human Roadmap: Clone Robotics Eyes Silicon Valley and $20,000 Price Points
